scenes.title: General-purpose computing leaves room for alternatives
scenes.narration: We don't know how to make a computer that runs all the programs except for the one that makes your shareholders sad. We just know how to make that one.

scenes.title: What this means in practice
scenes.narration: Technical possibility is not permission, and not every device gives users practical access. Look for documented formats and authorized integrations. That is a safer starting point than assuming any connection you can build is allowed.
